description: Team Orion is a six-member team from Dhaka, Bangladesh, taking on the Field Shift challenge. Bangladesh's farmers face floods, salinity, heat and shifting rainfall, and we want to help them use NASA Earth data to choose smarter crop rotations and protect soil health. We bring skills in software, data analysis, AI/ML, design and storytelling. Interested in remote sensing, GIS or agronomy? Reach out!
summary:
ORION is an AI-assisted agricultural intelligence project that helps Bangladeshi farmers make climate-informed crop-rotation decisions using NASA Earth observation and climate data. Through its Field Shift platform, ORION evaluates possible Aman → Rabi → pre-monsoon crop rotations across all 64 districts of Bangladesh, considering historical weather patterns, rainfall, monsoon onset, soil salinity, and agricultural constraints.

Farmers can explore ranked crop-rotation strategies, understand the reasoning behind each recommendation in Bangla or English, and simulate alternative climate scenarios such as hotter temperatures, reduced rainfall, and delayed monsoon onset. By transforming complex satellite and climate observations into explainable agricultural insights, ORION aims to make Earth science more accessible and support climate-resilient farming in Bangladesh.
details:
ORION, developed by Team Orion, is an agricultural decision-support project designed to help farmers in Bangladesh adapt to changing climate conditions using NASA Earth observation data.

Problem

Bangladeshi farmers increasingly face unpredictable rainfall, changing monsoon patterns, rising temperatures, water shortages, and soil salinity. These environmental challenges make crop selection and seasonal planning increasingly difficult.

Our Solution

ORION delivers Field Shift, a bilingual agricultural intelligence platform that converts climate and Earth observation datasets into practical crop-rotation planning insights.

1. NASA Data Integration

We developed an offline Python data-processing pipeline integrating approximately 45 years of NASA POWER daily weather observations, NASA/JAXA GPM IMERG precipitation data, and NASA MERRA-2 atmospheric and ocean-related climate indices.

These datasets are combined with Bangladesh-specific soil salinity information from SRDI and crop salt-tolerance references from FAO.

2. District-Level Agricultural Analysis

The platform covers all 64 districts of Bangladesh and includes six demonstration farms. It evaluates potential Aman → Rabi → pre-monsoon crop rotations using historical climate conditions, crop calendars, environmental constraints, and agricultural requirements.

3. Intelligent Crop-Rotation Ranking

ORION evaluates candidate crop rotations using eight scored components, agricultural calendar restrictions, and soil-salinity constraints.

Users can adjust farmer-priority sliders to explore different planning objectives and compare alternative crop rotations.

4. Explainable Recommendations

Each recommended rotation includes a "See Why" breakdown that explains the factors contributing to its score. Farmers can explore recommendations in Bangla or English rather than relying on unexplained predictions.

5. Climate Scenario Simulation

The platform allows users to explore alternative environmental conditions, including hotter temperatures, reduced rainfall, and delayed monsoon onset, to understand how changing climate conditions may influence crop-rotation suitability.

6. Machine Learning-Based Monsoon Outlook

We developed a LightGBM-based monsoon-onset outlook model using historical climate and precipitation information. The model was evaluated through leave-one-year-out validation against a climatological baseline. Its measured improvement over the baseline was approximately 0.9%, which we report transparently.

The platform also includes a live NASA POWER nowcast card with saved-data fallback.

Technology Stack

  • Frontend: Next.js and TypeScript
  • Data Processing: Python
  • Machine Learning: LightGBM
  • Climate Data: NASA POWER, GPM IMERG, and MERRA-2
  • Agricultural Data: SRDI soil salinity and FAO salt-tolerance references
  • Geospatial Data: geoBoundaries
  • Application Language: Bangla and English

Testing and Reliability

At the time of our local submission, the project had 262 passing pytest tests and 692 passing Vitest tests. The repository includes technical documentation, dataset references, and implementation details.

Innovation and Impact

The key innovation of ORION is transforming large-scale Earth observation and climate information into explainable agricultural planning options.

Rather than simply visualizing satellite imagery or historical weather information, ORION connects environmental conditions with crop-rotation decisions.

Our goal is to improve access to climate intelligence, support climate-resilient agriculture, and demonstrate how publicly available NASA resources can help address real-world agricultural challenges in Bangladesh.

Future Development

Future work includes improving forecasting performance, incorporating additional locally verified agricultural observations, expanding farm-level personalization, and validating recommendations with agricultural experts and farming communities.

ORION demonstrates how NASA Earth science can be transformed into accessible and practical tools for agricultural climate adaptation.
